newsitem.title: USA: BankAmerica shareholders approve stock split.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica shareholders approve stock split.

text.p: BankAmerica Corp said Thursday that shareholders approved a two-for-one stock split proposed by the board of directors in March, along with a proposal to increase the authorized shares of common stock from 700 million shares to 1.4 billion shares.
The split takes effect on June 2.

BankAmerica chief executive officer David Coulter told shareholders he hoped continued attention to the fundamentals, plus new top-line revenue growth in businesses that return more than their cost of capital, would enable the company to continue to outperform its peers.
